stories.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
stories.explanation: OpenAI released 'GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast', a model optimized for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs that provides up to 8x faster token generation for coding and interactive applications.

stories.title: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data
stories.explanation: A patched vulnerability in OpenAI’s ChatGPT Mac app could have allowed hackers to access chat logs and other sensitive data. This highlights the security risks associated with AI software that requires deep system access.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Chegg and Penske antitrust lawsuits targeting Google AI search
stories.explanation: A US federal judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits by Chegg and Penske Media against Google regarding AI search products like AI overviews. The court ruled that Google's use of content for AI answers is not an antitrust violation.

stories.title: Introducing Olmo-core 3: Open, scalable training infrastructure for large MoEs
stories.explanation: The Ai2 team released 'Olmo-core 3', an open training framework designed to scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model training into the trillion-parameter range.

stories.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture Venezuela’s president
stories.explanation: Elon Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged President Trump to capture Venezuela’s president, Nicolás Maduro, according to a Time magazine report. This raises concerns about the influence of AI chatbots on political decisions.

stories.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
stories.explanation: NVIDIA announced the DGX Spark 64GB, a local AI platform designed for running and clustering AI agents on-device using the NVIDIA AI software stack.

stories.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground
stories.explanation: Google launched its first advanced chip, a Tensor Processing Unit, into orbit to test its functionality in space for future space data centers. This is a step towards developing orbital compute clusters.

stories.title: With most information hidden, the game Stratego had stumped AI—until now
stories.explanation: Researchers developed an AI called Ataraxos that beat a top human player in the imperfect-information game Stratego. This represents a significant advancement in AI's ability to handle games with hidden information.

stories.title: Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers
stories.explanation: Amazon is urging public support for AI data center projects, warning that blocking them could harm the US economy and national security. Amazon Web Services CEO Matt Garman addressed concerns about jobs, power, and the environment.

stories.title: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
stories.explanation: AI music maker Suno launched a new Speech feature that generates spoken voices based on scripts or descriptions, with optional AI background music. This expands Suno's capabilities beyond music generation to include synthetic voiceovers.
